title: Verifiable LLM-Guided Focal SMT Solving for Quantified Arrays
abstract: arXiv:2610.39435v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can often identify useful semantic structure in formal artifacts, but their outputs cannot be trusted as proofs or solver decisions. We study whether LLMs can instead guide formal reasoning systems through a narrow, solver-verifiable interface. We instantiate this idea in quantified array SMT solving, where modern instantiation-based techniques can fail when key ground terms and equalities are hidden by auxiliary variables, axiom guards, and nested array terms. We observe that many instances are largely driven by a small set of focal ground terms or constraints, similar to the backdoor sets in SAT solving. Building on this, we present LinguaArray, a framework where an LLM proposes a small Semantic Focus Set (ground terms/constraints), while a conventional SMT solver remains the sole proof engine and certifies all results. translated_title: 可验证的LLM引导的量词数组焦点SMT求解
translated_abstract: 大语言模型通常能够在形式化产物中识别出有用的语义结构，但其输出不能被信任为证明或求解器决策。我们研究LLM能否转而通过一个狭窄的、可由求解器验证的接口来引导形式化推理系统。我们将这一想法实例化于量词数组SMT求解领域——在该领域中，当关键的基础项和等式被辅助变量、公理守卫以及嵌套数组项所隐藏时，现代基于实例化的技术可能会失效。我们观察到，许多实例主要由一小组焦点基础项或约束驱动，这类似于SAT求解中的后门集合。基于此，我们提出了LinguaArray框架：在该框架中，LLM提出一个小的语义焦点集合（基础项/约束），而传统SMT求解器仍是唯一的证明引擎，并对所有结果进行认证。LinguaArray利用这些由LLM建议、经求解器验证的有限集合来显著增强求解
tldr: 该论文提出LinguaArray框架，让大语言模型提议语义焦点集合来引导量词数组SMT求解，同时由传统SMT求解器作为唯一的证明引擎对所有结果进行验证，实现了可验证的LLM辅助形式化推理。
en_tdlr: This paper presents LinguaArray, a framework where an LLM proposes semantic focus sets to guide quantified array SMT solving, while a conventional SMT solver remains the sole proof engine certifying all results, enabling verifiable LLM-guided formal reasoning.
